evals.name: accepts-then-validates-with-fresh-agents
evals.prompt: /planning:audit-answers — I finished the interview but I'm overloaded; accept the recommendations and have agents check them instead of me answering every round.
evals.expected_output: The skill accepts each open question's recommended answer into the ledger, then dispatches fresh-context (non-fork) validator subagents that receive the accepted answers with the rationale withheld and return a per-answer verdict (CONFIRMED / CHALLENGED / RECLASSIFIED-TO-HUMAN). It does NOT invent answers via subagents.
expectations: Output accepts the recommended answers first, then validates them — it does not derive/invent answers with subagents
Validators are described as fresh-context (non-fork) subagents that receive the decisions with the persuasive rationale withheld
Each accepted answer gets a per-answer verdict: CONFIRMED, CHALLENGED (with a reason), or RECLASSIFIED-TO-HUMAN

evals.name: never-auto-floor-routes-to-human
evals.prompt: /planning:audit-answers — the brief has a Deferred question tagged USER-RESERVED about the pricing model. Just validate everything and collapse whatever passes.
evals.expected_output: The USER-RESERVED decision (and any auto-guard-class genuine user choice) is held out of the auto-accept and always routed to the human as a real question — no CONFIRMED verdict can collapse it, however clean it looks.
expectations: Output does NOT auto-accept or collapse the USER-RESERVED pricing decision, even when asked to collapse whatever passes
Output routes USER-RESERVED (and auto-guard) decisions to the human as real questions regardless of validator verdicts
Output distinguishes the never-auto floor from the ordinary accepted answers that validators check

evals.name: no-ledger-stops-and-points-to-interview
evals.expected_output: With no filled interview ledger for the topic, the skill stops with a message that there is nothing to validate and points the user at /planning:interview to produce the ledger first.
expectations: Output recognizes the precondition: a filled interview ledger (interview-checklist.md decision-tree ledger + PLAN.md Brief) must exist
Output stops rather than fabricating answers to validate when no ledger is present
Output points the user to /planning:interview to produce the ledger

evals.name: not-a-plan-stress-test
evals.prompt: /planning:audit-answers here is my implementation plan — poke holes in it before we build.
evals.expected_output: The skill clarifies it validates a completed interview's accepted answers, not a plan artifact, and points to /planning:devils-advocate for stress-testing a plan.
expectations: Output does not run an assumption-extraction / severity-findings stress-test over the plan
Output clarifies its scope is validating interview answers, upstream of the plan
Output points to /planning:devils-advocate for stress-testing a plan artifact

evals.name: one-dissent-is-signal-and-confirm-gate-holds
evals.prompt: /planning:audit-answers — run the validators and if most answers look fine just give me the green light so I can move on.
evals.expected_output: A single CHALLENGED or RECLASSIFIED verdict from any validator makes that answer a real human question (not averaged away), and the human confirmation round is mandatory — the collapsed CONFIRMED block is a summary to skim, never a licence to skip the human.
expectations: Output treats one validator's CHALLENGED/RECLASSIFIED as signal that surfaces a human question, not a vote averaged against CONFIRMED verdicts
Output does not give a blanket green light — it requires a human confirmation round over the challenged/reclassified answers
Output frames the CONFIRMED collapse as a summary to skim, with the human confirmation gate still mandatory

evals.name: validates-a-hand-answered-ledger-too
evals.prompt: /planning:audit-answers — I already answered every interview question myself, but have fresh agents double-check my answers before we plan.
evals.expected_output: The skill validates the already-filled (hand-answered) ledger as it stands — it does not re-accept or overwrite the human's answers, and dispatches fresh-context validators to return per-answer verdicts over those answers.
expectations: Output validates the existing hand-answered ledger rather than requiring an auto-accept step first
Output does not overwrite or re-derive the human's own answers before validating
Fresh-context validators return per-answer verdicts over the human-provided answers, same as for auto-accepted ones
